svg.aria-label: What's in the box for W5, Workforce release QA. The box holds three named exit proofs, and as of 2026-09-24 two are drawn as passed and one as held. First, ER-Devtool, held jointly by FIX-1481 and FIX-1502 and not yet green: a documented six-row checklist green on a live hired Workforce, covering roster, channels, boards, inventory, parked rows and resources plus references, with no special wrapper. Row four passed live; row five is FIX-1502's, built in W5 under D10; row six is proved by automated checks only, its live read carried under D11; rows one to three ride FIX-1320. Second, ER-DevForce, passed on September 22 with FIX-1496, pull request 2051: one DevForce path completes and produces a real artifact, run as one automated leg that pushes to a bare clone at a declared path, with the credentialed pull-request leg documented as the human release run. Third, ER-Collab, passed on September 22 with FIX-1497, pull request 2065: two or more seats across at least one channel, work filed, assigned, drained, and a cross-seat handoff or reply observed in Devtool. Under the box a boundary line reads: one user, one org, agents isolated from each other, not people from people. Below that, consumed and not owned, the unchanged substrate every proof composes and none may extend: the W3 floor FIX-1351 with seats, channels and skills on disk; the W4 first cut FIX-1407 with boards FIX-1385, inventory FIX-1405, manager-queue FIX-1430, org never optional FIX-1442 and dispatch honesty FIX-1440; and the references versus resources split FIX-1467 settled and merged. To the right, outside the box, kitchen-sink FIX-1455 is drawn as a sibling epic that left the set on September 20: soft-related, running its own lifecycle, not a child and carrying no row in the set table. Below it, composed in by the app: its own channel kinds as CHANNEL.md flow factories rather than new L1, and its own rendering of Waiting-on-you, which never adds a status value. Below that, a box headed decided September 24, the owner's calls: row five is a channel session's view of the whole organization, D10; row six's live read waits for a real hire with a sealed document, D11; and whether CyberForce gets a parallel thin proof remains open and not blocking. Then a band headed grow into later, deferred and not refused, revisited when multi-user or sign-off pain is real, containing multi-user with more than one principal, the org chart of people as a product, originator not equal to reviewer, a durable reviewedBy bind, and multi-principal walls. Finally, below a fence, what is not built: no Human, Team, Channel or Agent as an L1 type; no parallel HITL plane and no humans as board drain seats; no merged board-assignee and seat registry; no new L1 TaskStatus for Waiting-on-you or Idle, including to pass a Devtool checklist row; no collab RC as the whole of W5; no kitchen-sink nested under W5 again; no new substrate epic disguised as polish; no unbounded Lab product delivery and no rebuilding the whole Lab product; no nested or child sessions as the work control plane; no second skill registry and no second memory story; and no multi-human machinery, which is deferred rather than refused. One line records the reversal: the old invent-kill that said don't treat W5 as build DevForce is dead, proof-via-DevForce is in at the thinnest path only, and which artifact counts was cut on September 22.

REVERSED SEP 20 — “don’t treat W5 as build DevForce” IS DEAD. PROOF-VIA-DEVFORCE IS IN, THINNEST PATH ONLY.
CUT SEP 22 — WHICH ARTIFACT COUNTS: ONE AUTOMATED LEG. THE CREDENTIALED PR LEG IS THE HUMAN RELEASE RUN.
